consent_description: Your participation in this research study.
consent_intro: Participation is voluntary. Your data is processed in pseudonymized form: you are assigned a random participant ID so you can track your contributions, and researchers cannot access your personal identifying information.
consent_bullet_1: Every questionnaire you complete counts toward the ongoing study.
consent_bullet_2: Each batch runs for a fixed period with a small questionnaire set.
consent_bullet_3: Completing a batch before it closes maintains your participation streak.
consent_referral: Referral patterns from sharing this study with friends and colleagues are used only to reconstruct the network structure of the research community.
consent_rights: You can review your data, withdraw your consent, or request deletion at any time, in accordance with the GDPR and Indonesia's Personal Data Protection Law (UU PDP). Withdrawal does not affect processing carried out before withdrawal.
widget_note: Every questionnaire you complete counts toward the ongoing study
participant_data_note: Individual participant data will be available after anonymization upon study completion.
referral_notice: A friend invited you to this research. Completing the batch gives them community credit. Referral patterns are used only to study the structure of the research community.
